The '''snap shot blaster''' was an easily concealed [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] that was favored by intelligence agents, undercover [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement officers]], and criminals. A variant of a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], it was often used as a last resort. [[Morrigan Corde]] used a snap shot blaster pistol in emergency situations.<ref name="LECG" />
